DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Auto-linked from the Postgres companion service.

SERVER_ADMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: A long random string for administrative API access. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

FRONTEND_URL.description: Public URL where your Ryot instance will be accessible. Leave empty to auto-detect from Railway public domain.

API_URL.description: Internal backend API URL (fixed wiring — do not change).
